source.citation: Eiken O, Kölegård R, Bergsten E, Grönkvist M. G protection: interaction of straining maneuvers and positive pressure breathing. Aviation, Space, and Environmental Medicine 2007;78:392-398. Numbers as tabulated by Copeland K, Whinnery JE, DOT/FAA/AM-23/6, 2023, Table II.
source.read: abstract, and the citing report's Table II

conditions.onset: Rapid; rate not in the abstract; runs stopped at +9 g
conditions.event: Load at full peripheral light loss

assumptions: Each run is reconstructed as a jump from rest held 15 s.
Full peripheral light loss is read as the symptoms event, which needs less loss: a model that meets this criterion will show it at a slightly lower load.
Protected values are lower bounds: runs stopped at +9 g. Suit alone is the protected pilot without straining.

A different study from the fitted relaxed thresholds (C54): the relaxed value is held out. No other study gives protection, so the protected values are fitted and nothing protects them from overfitting.
